title: Spec Security Plugins for Claude Code
summary: A high-performance suite of security and formal verification plugins designed to extend the Claude Code CLI with agentic workflows. It automates complex tasks including coverage-guided fuzzing, sandboxed penetration testing in Kali Linux, and smart contract auditing for Solana.
research_notes: Developed by workers.io; can be installed directly via 'npx skills add workersio/spec' and includes specialized commands like /fuzzer and /solana-audit.

evolution.summary: Evolved from basic security scripts into a robust formal methods and offensive security framework. Notable additions include Kani-based Rust verification, Axiom for Lean 4 proof repair, and the 'Kage' isolated pentesting environment.
